title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: glazing and balustrades
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Glass balustrades on balconies
swms.task: Install glass balustrades and handrails on the apartment balconies at the edge, lifting glass panels with vacuum lifters, and sealing with silicone.

facts.fallControl: Temporary edge protection stays in place except at the panel being installed, opened under permit, and workers there use travel restraint to engineer designed anchors so they cannot reach the edge.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the silicone sealant are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves.
facts.harnessSystem: Workers wear a full body harness with a restraint lanyard of 1.5 m, set so they cannot reach the edge, clipped to anchors installed and rated by the anchor installer. Harnesses and lanyards are checked by the user before each use and inspected by a competent person every 6 months, recorded on the tag. Users are trained in working at heights by a registered training organisation.

swms.title: Shower screens and internal glazing
swms.task: Install shower screens and mirrors in the apartments, drilling into the tiled walls for fixings and sealing with silicone.

facts.silicaControls: Tile drilling is done with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while drilling. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the silicone sealant are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves.

rules.phrase: opened only at the panel being installed
